name: Spy Extraordinaire (CR 1)

SPY EXTRAORDINAIRE
CR 1

CG Medium humanoid (human)

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+1 armor, +2 Dex, +1 dodge)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 16
Base Atk +0, CMB +0, CMD 12
Traits Mentored, Tenacious Shifting

Languages Common, Dwarven
SQ bloodline arcanas, silver tongue 7/day
Gear armored kilt, dagger, light crossbow with 10 bolts, sorcerer’s kit, 4 gp
